FileSystemManager.readdir(Object object)

Read the list of files (including folders) in the directory(Minimum version: 23.6.0).

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
dirPath String Yes Directory path to read. (Local path, which can only be in the usr directory. It can be a relative directory. However, the final real path cannot be outside the usr directory. Temporary paths and cache paths cannot be read.)
success Function No Callback function that is successfully invoked.
fail Function No Callback function that fails to be invoked.
complete Function No Callback function that ends the interface invoking. (This function is executed when the interface is successfully invoked or fails to be invoked.)
success Callback Function
Object res
Attribute Type Description
files Array Array of file names (including files and folders) in a specified directory

Sample Code

let fs = ma.getFileSystemManager();

fs.readdir({
  dirPath: `${ma.env.USER_DATA_PATH}/testDir`,
  success(res) {
      console.log(res);
  },
  fail(err){
      console.log(err);
  }
});

Tips

  1. The value of dirPath must ensure that each level in the path is a folder. Otherwise, the interface returns the following error information: no such file or directory ${dirPath}
